verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API [lm-studio-docs-9] and OpenAI-like endpoints [lm-studio-docs-5], but it never mentions an official LM Studio client library or SDK for Python, JavaScript, or any other language. A raw HTTP API, or compatibility with third-party OpenAI clients, is an adjacent building block, not an official client library. Absence of evidence for this applicable capability is therefore 'none'.
